title: Al-Qaeda negotiating with Pakistani nuclear scientists after 9/11

tellings.quote: they were negotiating with Pakistani nuclear scientists to try to acquire a nuclear weapon they could use in the United States.

plain: After the 9/11 attacks in 2001, al-Qaeda was talking with Pakistani nuclear scientists to get a nuclear weapon it could use inside the United States. That is what Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer who worked on the threat at the agency's counterterrorism centre, tells Michels. He brings in the CIA director George Tenet and credits a book called A State of Mind: Faith and the CIA. If true, it shows how close the country came to a terrorist nuclear attack.
